error_text.room_missing: Wait. I lost the room record. That's on my side, Layla, not yours.
error_text.cannot_go: No, sorry. The route sheet doesn't show a path to {target} from there.

error_text.actor_unknown: I can't match {target} to anyone near you. Check the name for me.
error_text.feature_unknown: I can't match {target} to anything in the room. The recognition guide says to try a simpler name.
